nina-infra: heads up — rack r12 nodes (n12-01..n12-04) are showing thermal-induced GPU clock stepping, tail latency spikes for some tenants :thermometer: :fire:

alex-sre: any telemetry / traces?

maria-sre: VRM temps across those nodes hit ~92C, fans are ramping but some controllers report stale PWM values. spike started ~05:10 UTC, coincides with a batch job surge on shared-pool.

pradeep-ops: are implicated workloads on Dedicated or Shared? proactive evacuations will affect committed capacity for some customers. cost / SLA implications?

nina-infra: two affected nodes currently running mixed tenants: one Dedicated slice (ded-A) and a few shared containers. My proposal: proactive evacuate affected nodes into spare-thermal pool, mark rack r12 as cooling-window for 30m, then apply firmware patch to fan controller.

carmen-plat: we need safe handoff for dedicated tenants. options: (A) migrate ded-A to hot-standby hosts (reserved) with live-attach, (B) failover to compatible quantized variant (lower perf) temporarily. Which has lower SLA risk?

alex-sre: live-attach is prefered but we don't always have homogeneous hardware. If hot-standby not available, route ded-A to ded-fallback (lower perf), keep track for billing/credit. ops: notify account team.

maria-sre: telemetry query below if you want to reproduce: 
```
# telemetry quick-check
SELECT node, gpu_temp_c, gpu_clock_mhz, fan_pwm FROM telemetry.samples
WHERE rack = "r12" AND ts > now() - interval '10 minutes';
```

nina-infra: evacuation checklist I'm proposing: 
1) cordon nodes n12-01..n12-04
2) mark routing policy: `set-routing r12 --fallback=spare-thermal`
3) drain pods with graceful 60s and allow live-migrate for ded slices
4) patch fan firmware + trigger thermal-calibration
5) validate telemetry for 15m before uncordon

commands: 
```
kubectl cordon n12-01 n12-02 n12-03 n12-04
kubectl drain n12-01 --ignore-daemonsets --grace-period=60
routectl set-fallback --rack r12 --pool spare-thermal
```

pradeep-ops: question — will `routectl set-fallback` bump requests into shared-slicing? we should ensure token-cost accounting remains accurate. also add a preempt-safety so we don't evict burst tenants on reserved hardware.

carmen-plat: agree add `--respect-dedicated` flag to avoid auto-preempt unless tenant opted in. Also add audit event so billing team can review credits.

opsbot: incident created: INC-2026-thermal-r12, paging on-call (maria-sre).

maria-sre: I'll take on-call. Initiating evacuations in 2 minutes. Will update when nodes are drained and temps trending down.

alex-sre: also flag infra-runbooks: add a note about fan curve drift after firmware v1.3.7 — several vendors showed same pattern.

nina-infra: thanks. postmortem checklist: measure evacuation cost (tokens moved, preemptions), customer impact, and add a scheduled job to pre-warm spare-thermal pool during predicted heat windows.

pradeep-ops: pinging product to prepare messaging if ded customers see failover.

carmen-plat: I'll prepare the canary toggle: `infra.thermal_evacuate.enable` default=false, ramp to true for r12.

maria-sre: evacuations started — nodes cordoned, 3/4 drained, ded-A live-attach in progress. Temps dropping on n12-02.

alex-sre: nice. capture traces for a 30m window for SLA comparison.

nina-infra: updating runbook with command snippets and flags. Will follow up with a short blameless postmortem once stabilized. :white_check_mark:
